obligations.expected_basis: Source equation mirror ⟨⟩ = ⟨⟩ returns Leaf. NoTraits is neither Clone nor Ord, so the call also checks that mirror adds no accidental bounds.

obligations.case: Tree::<NoTraits>::Leaf is supplied as input and Leaf is expected as output
obligations.expected_basis: Tree_Test.tree.Leaf is the nullary constructor of Tree_Test.tree with no payload, and the first source equation mirror ⟨⟩ = ⟨⟩ preserves it.
By the second source equation mirror ⟨l,x,r⟩ = ⟨mirror r,x,mirror l⟩, with l = Leaf and r = Leaf, both recursive mirrors are Leaf, so the result is Node(Leaf, 7, Leaf).

obligations.case: Tree::Node(Box::new(Leaf), NoTraits(7), Box::new(Leaf)) is constructed and mirrored
obligations.expected_basis: Tree_Test.tree.Node has source fields [left subtree, value, right subtree]; the test constructs that exact order and checks the output keeps value 7 in the middle of a Node.

The second source equation gives Node(mirror right, 2, mirror left). Independently, mirror(Node(Leaf,3,Leaf)) = Node(Leaf,3,Leaf), so mirror(right) = Node(Leaf,4,Node(Leaf,3,Leaf)); mirror(left) = Node(Leaf,1,Leaf). The expected tree checked by the test is therefore Node(Node(Leaf,4,Node(Leaf,3,Leaf)), 2, Node(Leaf,1,Leaf)).

obligations.case: Nested Node constructions with values 1, 2, 3, and 4 and Leaf children
obligations.expected_basis: Each Node in the input uses source field order left subtree, value, right subtree. The checked output follows the source equation by recursively mirroring the right subtree into the left position and the left subtree into the right position.

obligations.case: Leaf appears as the empty children throughout the nested input and expected output
obligations.expected_basis: Leaf is nullary and the first source equation states mirror ⟨⟩ = ⟨⟩, so every Leaf subtree encountered recursively remains Leaf.

obligations.case: Tree<NoTraits> is built using only the source constructors Leaf and Node
obligations.expected_basis: Tree_Test.tree has exactly constructors Leaf and Node, with Node fields [left subtree, value, right subtree]. NoTraits supplies no Clone, Copy, Eq, Ord, or numeric operations, matching the unconstrained source type variable.

scope: Source-grounded finite tests with mechanical obligations and actual execution; not a formal proof or all internal-operation coverage.
